info.title: shiny-documentdb-mcp — an MCP server over a Shiny.DocumentDb store (stdio transport).
info.description: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Shiny.DocumentDb stores, over stdio. Point Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Copilot or any MCP client at a store and let it explore and query the data — read-only by default, with page caps and per-collection scope filters.

options.name: --types
options.description: expose only these TypeName discriminators (default: discover all)

options.name: --allow-writes
options.description:
unlock insert/update/delete — off by default, and each collection
must also opt in. A scoped collection can never be writable.

options.name: --help
options.description: Read-only unless --allow-writes is passed. Nothing not registered is visible.
